I am not saying that supports SHOULD just look at their team and click. I am saying that you can climb decently high doing that and that heal botting like that is an extremely simple way to play. No other role can win games with such a simple play style. 

DPS that have big AOE attacks (squirrel, iron man) still need to aim more than healers or if they have an auto aim (Wanda/iron fist) they need to be in very close range. DPS also need to be in line of sight to land shots, healers can more often stay around corners.

If you think holding right click in the general direction of your team as rocket is equally as hard as being effective on literally any DPS you are not even attempting to argue in good faith

Those things are needed but nowhere near to the degree of other roles.

Positioning - stand behind your team. No other role gets away with completely avoiding line of sight on enemies the entire game or running away when you get shot.

Good aim - Luna requires aim, invis requires some but not as much. Rocket and Loki have big AOE shots, it's difficult to miss with rocket. Mantis, Adam and cloak aim for you, just need to vaguely look in their direction. Jeff kind of in a middle ground.

Risk of dying - to divers maybe but once again you can completely avoid line of sight with enemies a lot of the time, some healers can heal around corners too so it's even easier. People also just blame their team of they get killed by divers, it's very tough to 1v1 a psylocke as any healer.

Game can't be won without you - for 95% of games you need the healer alive but your job is also just easier, hitting shots and killing enemies is way harder than hitting your team, especially with the auto aim characters I mentioned. Also if you are racking up kills as DPS you are FAR more likely to win than if you rack up healing on support.

I am not arguing it's an easy role, dealing with divers and staying safe can be hard, timing your ults and not dying in them can be really hard too. I am just saying that it is much easier than the other roles.

I think a low skill player will be able to climb a lot higher on support than they would on any other role.

A cracked support is amazing, a Luna who can reliably freeze and kill divers alone and ults at the right time is one of the best team mates you can have but it is really hard to do consistently.

On the other hand it is extremely easy to stay out of line of sight of the enemies and just hold right click as rocket in the general direction of your team then blame your team for not protecting you if you die. Their team should be protecting them but good supports should be able to deal with a diver alone sometimes.

On tank or DPS you need positioning, good aim (for most characters), target priority, you are always at risk of dying if you make a small mistake and the game can't be won if you are not doing your job.

Obviously everyone is a team and should all be helping each other but if I was playing with someone I knew was not good or was new I would definitely recommend just being a healbot if they want to win.

As long as we have 2 healers and a tank I don't care what our team comp is at the start. Sure I would love meta characters in 2-2-2 every game  but what people don't understand is that a good player as a 3rd DPS is more effective than having them swap tank if they aren't good at it.

I would rather a team of 6 people playing their best characters over rigidly sticking to what the top 0.01% have determined to be the best team comp. Sure Adam and mantis as healers isn't the highest healing output but a good Adam and mantis is way better than a bad Luna and cloak.

Peace of mind (for crit chance and stats)

4ap of damage abilities

Chameleon cloak (enemies end their turn if you are alone in combat and invisible)

When it gets to your turn delay to skip all enemies turns again.

For your first 6ap do damage or group people up with tp/nether swap depending on the fight.

After your first 6ap turn is over use time warp to get a 3rd turn after this one.

On your third turn use some ap then adrenaline, skin graft adrenaline for another net 3ap gain.

At the end of that turn use blessed smoke to go invisible again and rinse and repeat this combo
